answers.how: The shark is approximately 407 pixels long and moves about 633 pixels per second. Its length is 407 × 7 / 633 ≈ 4.5 m.
The shark moves straight left over 47/24 seconds, giving a displacement magnitude of 7 × 47/24 ≈ 13.71 m.
